title: Per-question timer (mock-exam mode)
summary: Tiny pure state machine (`{ status, startedAt, elapsedMs, allocatedMs }`) wrapped in a `<QuestionTimer />` React component on each question card in the companion app. Default allocation pulled from metadata.estimatedTimeMinutes (already stamped by Phase 3 revisionTipsBuilder). 'Mock-exam mode' toggle on the companion auto-starts every question's timer in sequence and locks back-edits when time expires.
motivation: Mock-exam practice is a universal Year 11 / Year 13 ask — and the existing companion app is the natural surface. Builds directly on G1's answer-entry surface.

in: client/src/components/QuestionTimer.tsx (new, ~120 LoC) — display + tick handler driven by useEffect
client/src/pages/companion/[token].tsx — wire the timer per question; mock-exam-mode toggle in the header
shared/aiSchemas.ts — additive: metadata.mockExamMode?: boolean; metadata.timeAllocations?: Record<sectionIndex, ms>
Targeted vitest: state-machine transitions; allocated time defaults; lock-on-expiry behaviour
out: Server-side enforcement of the time lock (v1 is client-side only — pupils can refresh; acceptable for revision; summative-mode lock is a Phase H follow-up)
Per-pupil time calibration via prior data (deferred to H1 / H10)

acceptance_criteria: Timer state-machine: idle → running on start → paused on pause → running on resume → finished on time-up; running → idle on reset.
Default allocation = metadata.estimatedTimeMinutes / questionCount when unspecified, capped at 5 min per question.
Mock-exam mode auto-starts the next question's timer when the previous finishes.
When time expires, the answer-entry input becomes read-only with a 'Time up — your answer is locked' message.
Component is keyboard-accessible (space pauses / resumes; Esc resets).
related: G1 — pupil auto-marking (the surface G13 attaches to)
H1 — pupil progress dashboard (reads time-on-task data)
